content.user_title: Draft HIPAA Documents for a Small Practice
content.value_statement: Small US practices need organized HIPAA documentation across risks, policies, vendors, training, and breach response. This guide helps an AI assistant draft those materials for review by counsel or a compliance officer.
actual_capabilities: Guides drafting an asset inventory and security risk analysis with threat identification and likelihood and impact scoring.
Outlines policies for access control, workforce sanctions, devices and media, contingency planning, and audit controls.
Guides drafting a vendor inventory and business associate agreement checklist referencing 45 CFR 164.504(e).
Outlines breach risk assessment and notification workflows, including a 60-day timeline and HHS reporting thresholds.
Provides an example documentation set that includes an initial workforce training log.
limitations: The package contains only a public guide; original scripts, extension source, and standalone templates are not included.
Coverage focuses on US HIPAA and excludes GDPR, other regulatory regimes, and additional state health privacy requirements.
Generated documents are working drafts, not legal certification or proof of compliance, and require professional review.
The guide does not perform technical system inspections, verify implemented safeguards, or submit breach notifications.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Initial Compliance File
use_cases.description: Draft a risk inventory, core policies, and training log for a small dental practice using a cloud EHR.

use_cases.title: Review a New Software Vendor
use_cases.description: Organize vendor information and a business associate agreement checklist before introducing software that handles protected health information.

use_cases.title: Structure a Suspected Breach Review
use_cases.description: Prepare a draft incident assessment and notification workflow for professional review using de-identified incident details.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Documentation Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a HIPAA documentation outline for a three-person dental practice using a cloud EHR. Include a risk analysis, core policies, and training log. Use fictional details and identify questions for our compliance officer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: organize a first documentation project.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Scored Risk Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this de-identified asset list, draft a HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis: [assets and safeguards]. Cover administrative, physical, and technical safeguards. Explain the likelihood and impact scale, distinguish assumptions from evidence, and prioritize proposed actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assess documented assets and safeguards.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Vendor and Agreement Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this de-identified vendor inventory: [vendors, services, and data access]. Draft a business associate agreement checklist referencing 45 CFR 164.504(e). Flag missing information and clauses for counsel to review without declaring any vendor compliant.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a vendor onboarding review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Breach Assessment Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this de-identified suspected incident summary: [facts, discovery date, affected systems, and estimated scope]. Draft a breach risk assessment and conditional notification workflow. Explain how discovery dates, applicable deadlines, and HHS reporting thresholds affect the draft. Separate unknown facts from conclusions and identify decisions requiring counsel.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: structure an incident review without making a final legal determination.

output_examples.input: Draft a starter documentation outline for a three-person dental practice with a cloud EHR.
output: Security Risk Analysis: Inventory the cloud EHR and local workstations, identify threats, and record proposed likelihood and impact scores.
Core Policies: Draft access control, workstation security, workforce sanctions, contingency planning, and audit control policies.
Vendor Review: List EHR and IT vendors, identify potential business associate relationships, and record agreement review status.
Training Log: Include staff role, training date, topic, and completion evidence.
Review Status: Mark assumptions and route drafts to counsel or the compliance officer.

output_examples.input: Prepare a preliminary review outline after a practice laptop is reported missing.
output: Known Facts: Record the discovery date, device custodian, and available incident details without patient identifiers.
Open Questions: Confirm whether protected health information was stored, encryption was effective, and unauthorized access may have occurred.
Assessment Draft: Document available evidence and unresolved questions before reaching a breach determination.
Notification Planning: Identify potentially applicable deadlines and reporting pathways for counsel to confirm.

best_practices: Use fictional or de-identified information and avoid entering patient identifiers, credentials, or other sensitive data into prompts.
Provide accurate asset, vendor, and safeguard inventories, and distinguish implemented controls from proposed controls.
Have counsel or a compliance officer validate drafts against current federal and applicable state requirements before use.
anti_patterns: Treating generated drafts as certification that a practice complies with HIPAA.
Assuming documentation proves safeguards are implemented or business associate agreements are executed.
Applying a generic 60-day timeline to every incident without checking applicable deadlines, reporting thresholds, and legal advice.

faq.question: What does the downloaded package contain?
faq.answer: It contains one SKILL.md public guide. Original scripts, extension source, and standalone templates are not included.

faq.question: Does this certify HIPAA compliance?
faq.answer: No. It supports working drafts that require review by counsel or a compliance officer.

faq.question: Can it help with a security risk analysis?
faq.answer: It guides an asset inventory, threat identification, and likelihood and impact scoring. It does not inspect systems or verify safeguards.

faq.question: Does it cover state privacy laws or GDPR?
faq.answer: No. Its stated scope is US HIPAA, and additional state health privacy requirements are outside its coverage.

faq.question: How does it address business associate agreements?
faq.answer: It describes agreement drafting, a vendor inventory, and a checklist referencing 45 CFR 164.504(e). Counsel should review proposed agreements.

faq.question: Can I include real patient information?
faq.answer: Use fictional or de-identified details instead. This guide does not establish that your AI environment is approved to process protected health information.
